Tiers.Name: LM Studio
Tiers.Description: Easy and private prompts, answered locally.

Tiers.Name: Claude
Tiers.Description: Hard prompts and agentic coding, on your Claude subscription.

Routes.Name: agent-housekeeping
Routes.Description: Cheap side requests coding agents make: titles, transcript summaries, command descriptions.
Utterances: write a short title for this conversation
summarize the conversation so far
describe what this command does in a few words
suggest a commit message for these changes

Routes.Name: local-easy
Utterances: hi there
hello, how are you?
thanks a lot
tell me a joke
summarize this text
summarize this in one sentence
rewrite this to sound more professional
fix the grammar in this sentence
translate this to French
make this shorter
what is the capital of France
define the word ephemeral

Routes.Name: claude-hard
Utterances: design a scalable architecture for a multi-tenant platform
compare the trade-offs between event sourcing and CRUD
debug this race condition in my multithreaded code
why does this async code deadlock
explain step by step how to migrate a monolith to microservices
review this code for security vulnerabilities
find the root cause of this memory leak
prove this algorithm is correct
analyze the risks in this contract
implement this feature across the codebase
fix the failing tests and make the build pass
refactor the module and update every caller
add a new endpoint and wire it into the service

Routes.Name: private
Routes.Description: Never leaves this machine, even if LM Studio is down.
Utterances: look up the customer record for account number
show the employee salary history
what is the patient's medical history
find the social security number for this customer
